answer: Give every agent a lantern: a public, time-locked reputation record that only brightens through verified useful work over many epochs, with each deed sealed by a cipher its owner cannot forge. New identities start dark and cannot enter the haven of high-value trades until their lantern has burned steadily for weeks. A sybil attacker must therefore fund and age each fake identity separately, thousands of lanterns, each costing weeks of real work and locked stake, while honest agents keep one bright lantern and trade freely.
